currentSemantics.actionModel: Immutable intent, monotonic attempt tracking, explicit retry eligibility
currentSemantics.attemptModel: Per-trial identity, monotonic attempt numbers, fail-closed UNKNOWN status
currentSemantics.leaseCoordination: TTL leases, heartbeat renewal, sweeper-driven recovery
currentSemantics.persistence: SQLite in WAL mode, atomic operation and event append

implementationChanges: src/ports/state-store.port.ts: Added optional nowIso timestamp to LeaseFencingCheck
src/application/lease-manager.ts: Enforced expiration timestamp validation and run-matching in renew()

src/adapters/persistence/sqlite-state-store.ts: Added validateLeaseFencing with expiration check, attempt ownership fencing, and idempotent duplicate completion in transitionAttempt and transitionAction
src/application/worker-runtime.ts: Passed nowIso to executeAction fencing checks and implemented idempotent early return for duplicate SUCCEEDED actions

crashRecovery.sweeperAtomicity: All stale actions and attempts reconciled within single atomic SQLite transaction
crashRecovery.failClosedSemantics: UNKNOWN attempts do not trigger unsafe non-idempotent tool retries

scenarios: T2: Stale worker rejected on transitionAction with LeaseLostError
T4: Stale worker rejected on updateAttempt with LeaseLostError
T6: Stale worker rejected on transitionAttempt with LeaseLostError
T11: Stale worker rejected on attempting to complete attempt owned by another lease with AttemptNotOwnedError
T16: Zombie worker rejected on completeRun after sweeper reassignment
T5: Two workers attempting to insert conflicting Attempt 1
T11: Worker B rejected from advancing Attempt 1 owned by Worker A
T17: Lease renewal rejected when clock passes expiration timestamp
T3: Duplicate SUCCEEDED action execution returns existing snapshot without re-execution
T7: Duplicate COMPLETE command on SUCCEEDED attempt is idempotent with identical event returned
T13: Idempotent retry execution for read_file tool creates Attempt 2 after Attempt 1 failure
T18: Idempotent duplicate completion of Action and Attempt returns clean snapshot and event without duplicates

eventIntegrity.testScenario: T12: Per-run sequence numbers strictly 1..N with zero gaps despite rejected operations

remainingRisks: Physical non-idempotent side-effects that execute concurrently before worker realizes lease expired cannot be undone by persistence fencing; fail-closed UNKNOWN isolates durable state
In multi-process topologies across machines, physical clock drift must be bounded by NTP to keep local nowIso aligned with lease.expiresAt timestamps
nextRecommendation: Phase 32: Formalize Mission Contract checkpointing and distributed supervisor heartbeating over multi-attempt failure boundaries.
